notes: Fixed symmetric baseline policies only; no RL training or policy fitting.
Net P&L includes earned fees and paid gas; no inventory penalty is subtracted.
The same external market paths are used for every width and background level.
Only background liquidity per interval changes; capital, volatility, cadence and trade-size rule stay fixed.
Trade flow and pool prices respond endogenously to each liquidity configuration.
Lower background changes price impact as well as fee shares; depth_window is not a movement cap.
Mean impact and the fraction of trades exceeding ten ticks are retained in the results.
The nominal training defaults and production initializer are unchanged.
